tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Solid screen ground behind the gradient, and the fallback where no gradient is drawn.

tokens.name: grad-peach
tokens.usage: Screen gradient, top stop (warm peach).

tokens.name: grad-pink
tokens.usage: Screen gradient, middle stop (rose pink).

tokens.name: grad-lilac
tokens.usage: Screen gradient, bottom-left stop (lilac).

tokens.name: glass
tokens.usage: Frosted cards and sheets over the gradient, with a 24px background blur.

tokens.name: glass-strong
tokens.usage: Circular icon buttons, tab bar, icon tiles — glass that needs to read as a control.

tokens.name: glass-edge
tokens.usage: 1px inner edge on glass surfaces. Decorative.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Solid cards where no gradient sits behind (lists, sheets, the song page lower half).

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Wells: segmented track, piano-roll lane, meter track, search field.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: Empty part of sliders and scrubbers.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers on solid surfaces. Decorative only.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Outlines on secondary buttons and unselected chips. Kept soft on purpose (about 2:1 on glass in light mode), so these controls also carry a glass fill and a label; never the only edge of an input. Never on the bare gradient.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface, glass and gradient stop.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text (subtitles, artist, times) on every surface, glass and gradient stop.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: The dark play disc and the one main action per screen (Want to learn, Mark as learned); selected tab. In dark mode it flips to a light disc.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: peach
tokens.usage: Start of the slider/progress gradient, and warm highlights. Decorative: not for text.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Orchid. End of the slider gradient, difficulty dots, the Learning status, links and ghost buttons, the focus ring. As text, only on glass or solid surfaces, never on the bare gradient.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent fill.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Selected genre chip, art tiles. Text on it: ink.

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Learning status pill, active piano-roll lane. Text on it: accent or ink.

tokens.name: wave
tokens.usage: Waveform bars over the gradient (with a soft glow). Decorative.

tokens.name: record
tokens.usage: Record button and the recording indicator only.

tokens.name: on-record
tokens.usage: Icon on the record button.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Learned status, "saved offline" confirmations. Teal so it never pairs with record red by hue alone; always with a word or check.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Learned status pill ground. Text on it: success.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Input too quiet / clipping, preview-only notices. Always with a word.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner ground. Text on it: warning.

tokens.name: key-white
tokens.usage: White piano keys.

tokens.name: key-black
tokens.usage: Black piano keys.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard/VoiceOver focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset.

tokens.name: note
tokens.usage: Note bars in the piano roll and the highlighted note during playback.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Screen titles (iOS Large Title). Once per screen.

styles.name: hero
styles.usage: The song title on the now-playing hero, centered over the gradient.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Recording timer, tempo (BPM), transcription percentage. Tabular figures.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase line above a hero title or card title. One per block.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Song titles in lists and cards; button labels.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Listen first, then play it back to yourself.
styles.usage: Paragraphs, subtitles under a hero, settings rows.

styles.name: callout
styles.usage: Artist/composer and genre lines; chip labels; slider labels.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Status pills and tab labels. Uppercase for pills only.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside pills.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; icon-to-label in buttons.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Inner gaps in cards; slider row gaps.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side margins.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Glass card padding; between sections.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Above hero titles; around the play disc and record button.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Piano-roll notes, level meter, small art tiles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, icon tiles, segmented control.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Glass cards, sheets, the player.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, pills, sliders, the play disc, round icon buttons, the record button.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Glass cards and the floating player.

tokens.name: shadow-disc
tokens.usage: The play disc and record button only.

tokens.name: shadow-knob
tokens.usage: Slider and scrubber knobs.

tokens.name: blur-glass
tokens.usage: backdrop-filter blur on glass and glass-strong surfaces (SwiftUI: .ultraThinMaterial).
